description: Ω1 law spine: the gate (law.check), consent grants, capability-handle algebra, registry (journal replay), per-principal forbidden-action overlay (law.forbidden.set, D-310; vault-durable per D-325 with law.forbidden.reload), and shadow amendment. Replaces the Ω0 law-stub via recipe re-compile + atomic pin swap (D-213).

capabilities.justification: law.check journals every gate decision to the vault law-journal (host.journal.append); law.tokens.revoke delegates plugin token revocation to the host generation bump (host.tokens.revoke). D-325: law.forbidden.set journals the forbidden overlay to vault ns law and reloads it at boot (vault.append/query/get) — granted per-composition by the user-signed Recipe (agent.json), never by this manifest; compositions without the vault grant stay memory-only.
